newsitem.title: USA: Countrywide Credit funded loans fall in Nov..
newsitem.headline: Countrywide Credit funded loans fall in Nov..

text.p: Countrywide Credit Industries Inc, a residential mortgage lender and servicer, said on Tuesday it funded $2.8 billion of mortgage loans in November, a nine percent drop from $3.1 billion one year ago.

Although the total dollar volume of fundings declined during the month because there were three less working days, average daily fundings increased to $140 million from $124 million in October, Countrywide said.
The company's pipeline of loans in process totaled $4.7 billion at November 30 versus $4.5 billion last year.
"Countrywide's production sector performance during November was highlighted by increasing applications whic fueled pipeline growth," Angelo Mozilo, vice chairman, said in a statement.

Average daily applications in November increased 13 percent over the prior month to $208 million, the highest level in six months. Average daily refinance applications grew 40 percent in November with the bulk in the retail-oriented Consumer Markets Division, Countrywide said.
The company's servicing portfolio increased to $153 billion at November 30, 1996, 15 percent higher than the $133 billion portfolio at November 30, 1995.
